sezioneDescrizione: Change the password you use to sign in to Kidville.
labelAttualeTemporanea: The password you received by email
vincoloNuova: At least {minimo, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}, with one letter and one digit, and different from the one received by email
criteriTitolo: For the new password to be accepted:
criterioLunghezza: At least {minimo, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
criterioLetteraCifra: At least one letter and at least one digit
criterioDiversa: Different from the one you are using now
criteriRiepilogo: {fatti, plural, =0 {No requirement met} one {# requirement met} other {# requirements met}} out of {totale}
erroreAttualeMancante: Type the password you are using now.
erroreConfermaDiversa: The two passwords do not match: please type the repeated one again.
erroreGenerico: We couldn’t change your password. Please try again shortly: your current one is still valid.
erroreRete: We couldn’t reach Kidville. Please check your connection and try again: your current password is still valid.
erroreSessioneScaduta: Your session is no longer valid: sign in to Kidville again and retry changing your password.
successoSessioni: For your security you have been signed out on every device, including this one. Sign in again with the password you have just chosen.
successoSenzaSessioni: From now on you sign in with the password you have just chosen.
interstizialeIntro: The one you received by email was temporary: it was only meant to get you in the first time.
interstizialeNonOraNota: If you choose “Not now” we will ask you again at your next sign-in, and the command stays in your profile.
